answer: Each new agent identity must complete a unique hardware-attested cipher puzzle inside a TEE, producing a non-exportable falcon signature that is then endorsed by a bridge of three independent established agents who each post a bonded stake. An attacker forging n fake identities must acquire n distinct physical TEEs and secure 3n unique non-colluding endorsements; as the clean agent pool shrinks, the marginal cost of each extra alias grows superlinearly until the attack becomes uneconomic.
